name: Coalition of Consequence (draft)
description: Draft template: about 40 people forming shared perspectives and working groups on navigating the AI revolution. Stages will be remapped to Andy's facilitation framework once it is shared.

stages.label: Pre-call intake
stages.description: A short interview about what you see coming, your fears, your hopes and what you bring.

stages.label: Perspective map
stages.description: Agreement, tensions, issue clusters and unexpected alliances.

stages.label: Scope and priorities
stages.description: Draft scope statements and priority issues to respond to.

stages.label: Weekly digest
stages.description: A weekly digest of progress and drift.

stages.label: Alliances
stages.description: Suggested connections and small groups around emerging ideas.

intake.intro: Thanks for joining the coalition. I'll ask a few questions before our first call so the group can see where we agree, where we differ, and who might work together. You'll approve exactly how I summarise you before anyone else sees it.

topics.question: What do you see coming with AI over the next few years?
What expertise and networks do you bring?
Which issues would you act on?
Roughly how many hours a month could you give, and which days suit you?

profileFields.label: What they see coming
profileFields.description: Their view of what is coming with AI.

profileFields.label: Networks
profileFields.description: Networks and relationships they could draw on.

outputs.label: Tensions
outputs.description: Real disagreements, stated fairly from each side.

outputs.label: Issue clusters
outputs.description: Issues that group naturally and have people ready to act.

outputs.label: Unexpected alliances
outputs.description: Members who would not obviously connect but share a cause or complement each other.

outputs.label: Minority views
outputs.description: Views held by a few, kept visible.

proposal.label: Scope and working groups
proposal.guidance: Draft a scope statement and a small number of priority issues, each with a working group and a first deliverable.
